Security beefed up at Mujibnagar Complex
2020-12-08T22:44:40+06:00 | BSS, MEHERPUR
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/news/security-beefed-mujibnagar-complex-2008041

Mujibnagar Upazila Administration has beefed up security measures at Mujibnagar Complex and its surrounding areas.

Sujon Sarker, Mujibnagar upazila nirbahi officer said they sent a letter to the Public Works Department to set up close circuit television cameras in the Complex compound.

Anser members were seen taking position in the main gate and in and around a mural of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in the Complex, where sculptures of the four national leaders were also erected.

Atrocities of Pakistani armies perpetrated in country's liberation war in 1971 were also drawn there.
